_source: Static POI-proposal form config (formerly the non-account fields of the dropped fixture). Coordinate ranges (x: -150..163, y: -150..159), description length (20..250), co-author wallet shape (42-char addresses) and PoiType (add_poi / remove_poi) are verbatim from decentraland/governance src/entities/Proposal/types.ts newProposalPOIScheme. This is NOT a Catalyst read — POI map limits + copy are governance form config. votingPowerToPass is the VP a POI proposal needs to PASS once it reaches Snapshot voting (not a submission gate). There is no live createProposal endpoint reachable from this app (Snapshot + Aragon run the DAO externally); the submit step is SIMULATED.

copy.intro: Points of interest (POIs) are scenes that have been highlighted on Decentraland’s map in a ‘pin drop’ form, helping other users to quickly find and access especially interesting areas.

add.title: Add a Point of Interest
add.coordinatesLabel: What location do you want to add as a POI?
add.descriptionDetail: Why do you think that this location should be a featured point of interest within Decentraland? Please describe the scene located at these coordinates, explaining how it would be interesting or helpful for other Decentraland users.
add.descriptionPlaceholder: The scene located at 0,0 is both visually stunning and informative for new users. The interactive tutorial hosted here would provide people with a fun and enjoyable way to learn more about Decentraland.

remove.title: Remove a Point of Interest
remove.coordinatesLabel: What location do you want to remove as a POI?
remove.descriptionDetail: Why do you think that this location should be removed as a featured point of interest within Decentraland? Please describe the scene located at these coordinates, explaining why it is no longer an interesting or helpful place for other Decentraland users.
remove.descriptionPlaceholder: The scene located at 0,0 is no longer visually stunning for users. The location has been abandoned for a long time.
